tool.name: VTK Field Plot
tool.description: Render 3D scalar field isosurfaces from a VTK StructuredGrid as a PNG
tool.command: cp '$input_vtk' input.vts && python '$__tool_directory__/vtk_field_plot.py' --input-vtk input.vts --field-name '$field_name' --n-contours $n_contours --colormap '$colormap' --output-png output.png && mv output.png '$output_png'

param.name: input_vtk
param.label: VTK field volume
param.help: VTK XML StructuredGrid (.vts) from MFEM Time Series Demo or Magpy Field Solver

param.name: field_name
param.label: Scalar field name
param.help: Name of the scalar field to visualise — must match the field written by the upstream tool

param.name: n_contours
param.label: Number of isosurface levels
param.help: How many isosurface contours to generate across the field range

tool.help:
**VTK Field Plot**
Renders isosurface contours of a 3D scalar field (e.g. **Bz_total**) stored in a VTK XML StructuredGrid file and outputs a three-view PNG (front, top, isometric).
Use this tool for **quick in-Galaxy visual validation** of the magnetic field volume before feeding it into the Omniverse pipeline via **vtk_to_usd_volume**.
**Input**
A ``*.vts`` VTK XML StructuredGrid file as produced by:
- MFEM Time Series Demo (``output_vtk``) - Magpy Field Solver Time Series (``output_vtk``)
**Output**
Three-panel PNG showing the isosurfaces from front, top, and isometric viewpoints, coloured by the scalar field value.
**Field name**
Must match the field name written by the upstream tool. The default is ``Bz_total`` which is what both MFEM and Magpy tools write.
